firstPlayerRule: The youngest player takes the First Player token and is the first active player.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are tied, choose randomly among them.
clarifications: Each turn begins with all players rolling their dice simultaneously for Divine Blessings. The active player then resolves their own remaining steps.
The next player clockwise becomes active. The first player keeps the token for the whole game.
